statement: ONE SHOT on the colleague-written R2 set. Both configurations are run exactly once; scripts/eval_11_2.py refuses a second run. Nothing is tuned afterwards and NOTHING is adopted in this task - the recommendation is reported only.

precondition.verified_before_run: the harness re-checks every frozen sha256 and refuses to run on drift

gold.input_to_system: q['query'] ONLY - never notes, expected or mode

provenance_verbatim.queries: 20 symptoms written by colleagues working with the author, each with the writer's own label. Whether the writers had seen Round-1 material, or used writing tools, was not recorded; several topics overlap Round 1. No version of the system had been run on these queries before the pre-registered evaluation.
provenance_verbatim.labels: Writer's labels used unchanged (mostly a single DTC per row, so scoring is strict). Modes: 15 symptom (DTC expected), 4 no_dtc (mechanical, correct behaviour = decline), 1 inconclusive (excluded from scoring). Flags on R16 and R18 in notes.
provenance_verbatim.scoring: symptom rows: hit = any expected code, any decline is an error; no_dtc rows: decline is correct; inconclusive rows: reported, not scored. Report all-rows and a sensitivity analysis excluding R16 and R18.

symptom_rows.hit: any expected code in the returned list
symptom_rows.false_decline: ANY decline on a symptom row is an error and is listed by id

reported: per-row: was an inspection-area advisory shown when answered

subsets.EXCL_R16_R18: sensitivity analysis excluding R16 (concept overlaps Round-1 Q46, which informed refinement A, so it is not independent of A) and R18 (arguable label: a charge-air leak often triggers air-mass/boost codes)

uncertainty.paired_test: paired bootstrap of symptom MRR, A-narrow minus production, same resampled indices both sides
uncertainty.warning: n = 15 symptom rows and 4 no_dtc rows. These intervals are very wide and a single row moves MRR by up to 0.067. No difference here can be called significant; the run is a sanity check, not a measurement.

word_overlap: reported with src/gold_overlap.py for information only; no query is dropped or edited
adoption: NOT in this task. The report states a recommendation only.
